name: ieee-fraud-detection-analytics
description: End-to-end fraud risk intelligence platform: DuckDB → BigQuery → dbt → LightGBM → FastAPI → Vercel. 590K transactions, ROC-AUC 0.9134, live executive dashboard.

paragraphs: An evidence-first, historical fraud analytics project combining data engineering, time-aware machine-learning evaluation and an interactive NEXUS dashboard. Built on the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset; no competition data is redistributed here.

Project status (18 October 2026): Paused — maintenance/portfolio reference only. The canonical 590,540-row Kaggle temporal hygiene and calibration experiments are documented and reproducible; they are research evidence, not promoted production scores. Public Vercel exact-SHA release and current BigQuery reporting parity are not accepted. No more experiments, deployments or snapshot refreshes are scheduled for this project until the owner explicitly resumes it. See the handoff and remaining gates.
Screenshot captured on 14 October 2026; capture and hash provenance. It depicts an older deployed revision, not a live transaction feed.
